title: Multimodal AI use cases in real products

videos.script: This course is about models that see and hear. {{title}} Until now, everything you sent a model was text. Here it gets a scanned invoice, a phone call, a video. And sometimes it answers with a picture or a voice. {{directions}} That sounds like a new kind of software. Mostly, it is the old kind with bigger, stranger inputs. Every picture and every second of sound becomes something the model counts. And the count is the bill. {{count}} You will work in one lab, for one shop. Marginalia, the online bookshop from the earlier courses. It has invoices to read, calls to listen to, a video to caption and a phone line that should talk back. {{marginalia}} The models that listen and speak are real, and they run on the lab machine. The ones that look at pictures or draw them are a stand-in. Every lesson says which is which. {{lab}} By the end you will know what each kind of model is good for. You will also know how to measure when it is wrong. {{end}}
